speaker: Doctor
text: To better understand your symptoms, please describe when the double vision began and whether it worsens when you look down or up. Additionally, have you noticed any specific muscle weakness in your upper limbs or difficulty swallowing?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: That pattern of weakness improving with rest and worsening with activity is very suggestive of a neuromuscular junction disorder, but your double vision that worsens with downward gaze is also concerning for an ophthalmoplegia. Have you experienced any difficulty swallowing, choking on food, or changes in your voice quality? REQUEST TEST: Repeat_Nerve_Conduction_Studies
